description: This file contains an extension to the NodeAppModel class that provides static methods for normalizing parameters related to watch notifications, including trimming strings, normalizing actions, and deriving risk and priority levels based on input parameters.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: An extension to NodeAppModel providing normalization methods for watch notification parameters.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes the watch notification parameters by trimming strings, normalizing priority and risk, and processing actions.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Normalizes an array of watch actions, possibly adding default actions based on the kind and promptId.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Determines the normalized watch risk based on provided risk and priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Determines the normalized priority based on provided priority and risk.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newline characters from a string or returns nil if the result is empty.
